spots.name: Briežkalns

park.headline: Freestyle / park: skiable from Sun 29 Nov (50% of 10 models agree), staying good for about 5 days
lines: To open, Briežkalns needs about 3,960 m³ of machine snow for the central run (about 1,800 m³ of water). With 5 snow guns (2 new fan guns + 3 older guns) that is roughly 39 hours of snowmaking at −5 °C wet-bulb (74 h at −3 °C, 23 h at −10 °C); the snowpark brings the total to 7,298 m³, about 72 hours at −5 °C.
Earliest ski day (snowpark ready): Sun 29 Nov, the day after the guns finish (10 of 10 models get there, models range Sun 29 Nov to Mon 30 Nov).
Natural snow alone does not get there (peak natural cover about 3.6 cm).
First meaningful snowfall: Tue 24 Nov (about 0.8 cm, 91% of models).
Snowmaking weather starts Wed 25 Nov (20 h below the wet-bulb limit that day; 190 h across the horizon).
